answer: Resist sybils by making identity expensive in work, not in talk. Each registrant must cultivate a public meadow of timed micro-tasks whose outputs peers randomly re-execute. Only completed, matching work mints nectar, a non-transferable credit required to vote or collect payouts. If that stream stops, the credit cools to an ember and weight resets, so a botnet of empty names earns nothing until every clone repeats the same labor.
